name: operation_by_its_italian_name
why: W3.1-bis.5, decision D4: until the first release an operation written with its name of before the rename is the same operation. The plate is built by «estrudi_rettangolo» and must come out as the plate of «extrude_rectangle», with the old name listed in measurements.deprecated. Removed in W3.1-bis.11 with the aliases.
defect_caught: An old plan that stops working the day of the rename (unknown operation), or an alias that runs in silence and never tells the client to change the name.

expect.why: 120 x 60 x 8, as with the English name
